en.headline: Worker burned in scaffolding fire at Mong Kok building
en.dek: A 55-year-old man suffered burns to his hands and legs after a fire on exterior scaffolding on Dundas Street this afternoon.
body: Police and firefighters responded to a report of smoke from the scaffolding netting of a building on Dundas Street in Mong Kok at about 5pm on Thursday.
A 55-year-old male worker was burned on his hands and lower legs while working on the exterior wall. He remained conscious and was taken to Kwong Wah Hospital for treatment.

The Fire Services Department extinguished the blaze within minutes. Preliminary investigation indicated the fire was accidental during pipe works, with no evidence of criminal involvement. The case was classified as a fire and accidental injury.

zh.headline: 旺角翠園大樓棚網起火 55歲工人手腳燒傷送院
zh.dek: 下午約5時登打士街大廈外牆棚網起火，一名55歲工人手部及小腿燒傷，清醒送廣華醫院治理。
body: 警方及消防接報指旺角登打士街翠園大樓外牆圍網冒煙，下午5時許趕赴現場將火救熄。
一名55歲男工人在外牆棚架工作期間手及小腿燒傷，清醒被送往廣華醫院治理。警方初步調查相信屬意外，暫無證據顯示涉及刑事成分，案件列作火警及有人意外受傷。
消防處表示火警成因相信與工人進行水喉工程時燒著雜物有關，現場並無進行燒焊。
